name: strategy-squad
description: Run the Big 3 consultancies (McKinsey, BCG, Bain) as one rival AI strategy team: they fight, a judge panel runs an idea championship, a Blue Team builds on the wreckage, and the squad preps the human in the room with provocative questions and a pitch. Includes a human-gated autonomous loop mode and a compounding strategy-insights store.

author.name: Tim van den Bosch (Sitelane) with Joost de Leij
